title: Seedance 2.5 API opens, landing on Runway, Krea and Pika
summary: ByteDance switched on public API access for its 30-second video model, and Western creative platforms shipped it to users within hours of each other.
body:
## From demo to distribution

ByteDance opened public API access to Seedance 2.5 on 7 August, and the model appeared almost simultaneously inside a row of Western creative platforms. Runway announced availability first, followed within roughly ninety minutes by Krea, the agentic design tool Lovart, and Pika, which folded the model into its recently launched API membership at a steep discount. Several other platforms — among them Magnific, Yapper and YouArt — have announced integrations of their own, while ByteDance's Volcano Engine has been signing up Chinese apps directly. The model itself was unveiled on 31 July, but at that point it ran only inside ByteDance's own consumer apps — Jimeng and Doubao — with programmatic access listed as forthcoming. This week closed that gap.

The capability set is what makes the distribution notable. Seedance 2.5 generates up to 30 seconds of continuous audio-video in a single pass rather than stitching short clips, and it can organise multiple logically connected shots inside that span, so a sequence can carry setup, development and resolution without an editor intervening. It accepts as many as 50 reference inputs per generation — up to 30 images, 10 video clips and 10 audio clips — and supports timestamp-level editing of both picture and sound, alongside green-screen output and camera-angle adjustment.

## Pricing and positioning

Resellers list the model in the region of nine cents per second of output at lower resolutions, with token-based rates differing depending on whether video is supplied as input. That places it in direct competition with the incumbent Western video models on the same platforms that now host all of them side by side.

## Why it matters

The significant fact is not the model but the channel. A Chinese lab's flagship video model became, in the space of a single morning, a first-class option inside the tools most Western creators actually use — including platforms that build their own models. Video generation is consolidating into a thin layer of interface companies buying capability wholesale, and on this cycle the wholesale supplier was ByteDance. For rivals in the US and Europe, the competitive question shifts from whose model is better to whose model is cheap and available everywhere at once.
title_zh: Seedance 2.5 开放 API，同日登陆 Runway、Krea 与 Pika
summary_zh: 字节跳动正式开放这款 30 秒视频模型的公开 API，欧美主流创作平台在数小时内密集接入上线。
body_zh:
## 从演示走向分发

8 月 7 日，字节跳动正式对外开放 Seedance 2.5 的公开 API，该模型几乎同时出现在多个欧美创作平台上。Runway 率先宣布上线，约一个半小时内，Krea、智能设计工具 Lovart 以及 Pika 相继跟进，其中 Pika 把它塞进了刚推出的 API 会员体系并给出大幅折扣。此外，Magnific、Yapper、YouArt 等平台也已宣布接入，字节的火山引擎则在直接对接国内应用。模型本身在 7 月 31 日就已亮相，但当时只能在字节自家的即梦与豆包中使用，API 一直标注为「即将开放」。这一周补上了这块拼图。

真正让这轮分发值得注意的是模型能力本身。Seedance 2.5 单次可生成最长 30 秒的连续音视频，而非把短片段拼接起来；在这 30 秒内还能组织多个逻辑连贯的镜头，让一段叙事完成铺垫、发展与收束，中途无需人工剪辑介入。单次生成最多可接受 50 个参考输入——30 张图片、10 段视频和 10 段音频，并支持对画面与声音做时间戳级别的精修，同时提供绿幕输出与机位调整。

## 定价与站位

第三方渠道给出的价格在低分辨率下约为每秒九美分量级，按 token 计费时是否带视频输入会有差别。这一定位使其与欧美现有视频模型正面竞争——而这些模型如今正与它并列摆在同一批平台的模型选单里。

## 为何重要

关键不在模型，而在渠道。一个中国实验室的旗舰视频模型，在一个上午之内成为欧美创作者日常工具里的一等选项，其中还包括自研模型的平台。视频生成正在收敛为一层很薄的界面层公司加底层能力批发，而这一轮的批发商是字节跳动。对欧美同行来说，竞争问题正从「谁的模型更好」转向「谁的模型足够便宜、且到处都能调到」。
